summary: All three round-1 medium findings are resolved correctly in commit 6845945. (1) Race-test count assertions are loosened to setCount in [1,2] with delCount = setCount-1 and accompanied by inline comments explaining the legitimate interleavings; the strong race-correctness invariants (exactly-one CONNECTED row + {200,409} status pair) remain as hard assertions. (2) noTokenLeak now appends a leak-prone branch where setWebhook returns a Telegram 4xx with the token quoted inside `description`. The 500 response body is asserted via assertNoTokenLeak() (regex match + substring scan) — this would FAIL today if TelegramApiClient.toAppException ever started propagating the unscrubbed (or even scrubbed-but-still-token-shaped) description into AppException.getMessage() instead of the fixed string "Webhook configuration error", which is exactly the regression the test now guards against. (3) anyEndpoint_unauthenticatedBareClient_returns401 mirrors ProjectControllerIT verbatim: bare WebTestClient bound to ApplicationContext (not the @WithMockAppUser-mutated autowired client), exercises GET /, POST /connect (with csrf+body), POST /disconnect (with csrf), POST /test-message (with csrf), each asserting .isUnauthorized(). Round-1 low items were not addressed (e.g. the line-109 doc-comment still says @AfterEach while the resets live in @BeforeEach), but those are pre-existing and not regressions from the round-2 patch — acceptable as documented drift per the round-2 scope. Backend suite reports 343 tests passing. Verdict: approve.
